metadata.case_name: CHAN YUET KEUNG v. HARMONY (INTERNATIONAL) KNITTING FACTORY LIMITED

plaintiff.occupation_before: Supervisor at the defendant's textile weaving factory

injuries.description: At L5/S1, there was a central, left paracentral disc extrusion. The thecal sac was indented anteriorly. The central canal was narrowed. The extruded disc was compressing on the left descending nerve root.
source: At L5/S1, there was a central, left paracentral disc extrusion. The thecal sac was indented anteriorly. The central canal was narrowed. The extruded disc was compressing on the left descending nerve root.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of nerve root of lumbar spine

injuries.description: soft tissue injury to his back which was consistent with the mechanism of injury described by him, namely, that he had stepped on some waste bits of textile and fell back and landed on his buttocks and low back area.
source: soft tissue injury to his back which was consistent with the mechanism of injury described by him, namely, that he had stepped on some waste bits of textile and fell back and landed on his buttocks and low back area.
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of muscle, fascia or tendon of lower back

injuries.description: mild degenerative changes with small osteophytes around L3/4 and L4/5 discs were present.
source: mild degenerative changes with small osteophytes around L3/4 and L4/5 discs were present.
injuries.icd_description: Injuries to the abdomen, lower back, lumbar spine or pelvis

manifestations.description: tenderness at his lower back around L4/5 region
decreased range of movement of the back
mild reduction in straight-leg-raising on the left side
no objective neurological deficit on physical examination
inability to lift heavy loads as required by his work
8% permanent impairment of the whole person
some muscle guarding but no muscle spasm at the lumbar region
probable aggravation of pre-existing degeneration of the back (especially around L3/4 and L4/5 discs) resulting in persistent low back pain

treatments_received: attendance at Accident & Emergency Department (Alice Ho Miu Ling Nethersole Hospital)
medication for pain relief at Tin Shui Wai Health Centre

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: Probably some difficulty in cutting toenails
Disabled from returning to any form of heavy manual labour; loss of earning capacity
8% permanent impairment of the whole person
